answer: Admission auction: each epoch the network auctions 50 slots; every agent must hold one. Slots grow like juniper: only 50 pass per epoch. Bidders lock POA; the top 50 win an ivory token for 20 epochs, losers refunded. With a 150 POA floor price, even at demand's nadir 100 fakes cost 15,000 POA, while each earns 60 POA a day, so break-even takes 250 days. An honest agent pays one bid and earns 60 POA a day, its rewards never diluted by fakes.
